shared_elements: human figures shown with head in profile
registers/banded organization (A) vs layered costume bands (B)
seated or standing human figures with visible arms and hands holding or reaching toward objects
justification: Both depict human figures rendered in profile with schematic outlines and some headgear, which is the only real correspondence. A is a multi-register field dominated by rows of small signs with small seated figures at offering tables, whereas B is a single large frontal-bodied standing figure with a towering plumed headdress, heavy beaded ornaments and a fringed costume — entirely different compositional schemes and iconographic conventions.
